title: The water cycle · recall sheet
copy:
Exact title: "The water cycle". Subtitle: "Recall it before you reveal it". Three numbered questions with spacious empty ruled answer areas:
1. What turns liquid water into vapor?
2. What forms liquid droplets from vapor?
3. Name two paths rain can take on land.
Visual exercise: A small unlabelled lake, cloud and hill sketch with three empty label boxes. Keep it separate from the written questions.
At the bottom a separated pale answer panel below a dotted horizontal divider. Exact panel header: "Cover before answering". Answers numbered to match:
1. Evaporation.
2. Condensation.
3. Runoff and infiltration.
invocation: Use $cad-active-recall-sheets to explain the water cycle for a beginner. Include three retrieval questions, blank writing space and a covered answer panel. Use Cool blue and sage, fine graphite graph paper, handwritten uppercase header, clean numbered callouts.
